MarginAccount.name: Margin Account
MarginAccount.definition: Margin account where the negotiation and liquidation risks will be calculated.

DeliveryAccount.name: Delivery Account
DeliveryAccount.definition: Account opened by the central counterparty in the name of the clearing member or its settlement agent within the account structure, for settlement purposes (gives information about the clearing member/its settlement agent account at the central securities depository).

TradeLegIdentification.name: Trade Leg Identification
TradeLegIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction (that is the trade leg) as known by the instructing party.

TradeIdentification.name: Trade Identification
TradeIdentification.definition: Reference assigned to the trade by the investor or the trading party. This reference will be used throughout the trade life cycle to access/update the trade details.

TradeExecutionIdentification.name: Trade Execution Identification
TradeExecutionIdentification.definition: Unique reference assigned by the trading venue when the trade is executed.

UniqueTransactionIdentifier.name: Unique Transaction Identifier
UniqueTransactionIdentifier.definition: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

OrderIdentification.name: Order Identification
OrderIdentification.definition: Identifies the order sent by the final investor to an intermediary in order to initiate a trade in the former's name. This identification is then matched with the equivalent trade by the clearing.

AllocationIdentification.name: Allocation Identification
AllocationIdentification.definition: Identifies the portion of assets within a determined trade that shall be allocated to different clients.

NonClearingMember.name: Non Clearing Member
NonClearingMember.definition: Provides details about the non clearing member identification and account.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Provides the date or date and time of trade transaction.

TransactionDateAndTime.name: Transaction Date And Time
TransactionDateAndTime.definition: Date and time used to determine the price applicable to a trade. If the trade is registered "after market" hours, the trading price will the price of the day but the actual trade date will be the next working day.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Provides details about the security identification.

TradingCurrency.name: Trading Currency
TradingCurrency.definition: Specifies the ISO code of the trade currency.

BuySellIndicator.name: Buy Sell Indicator
BuySellIndicator.definition: Identifies the trade leg indicator which gives the trade side (buy or sell).

TradeQuantity.name: Trade Quantity
TradeQuantity.definition: Identifies the quantity of the trade leg.

DealPrice.name: Deal Price
DealPrice.definition: Specifies the price of the traded financial instrument.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest that has accumulated on a bond since the last interest payment up to, but not including, the settlement date.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Place at which the security is traded.

PlaceOfListing.name: Place Of Listing
PlaceOfListing.definition: Place at which the security is listed.

TradeType.name: Trade Type
TradeType.definition: Identifies the type of trade transaction.

TradeTransactionCondition.name: Trade Transaction Condition
TradeTransactionCondition.definition: Indicates the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was excuted.

DerivativeRelatedTrade.name: Derivative Related Trade
DerivativeRelatedTrade.definition: Indicates that the trade is for settlement of an exercised derivatives contract.

Broker.name: Broker
Broker.definition: Party that identifies a broker when required (for example, authorised broker or prime broker).

TradingParty.name: Trading Party
TradingParty.definition: Provides the identification of the trading party.

TradeRegistrationOrigin.name: Trade Registration Origin
TradeRegistrationOrigin.definition: Indicates in which session the transaction/operation was executed by the final investor or an intermediary.

TradingPartyAccount.name: Trading Party Account
TradingPartyAccount.definition: Identifier of the trading participant's account at the trading venue using the venue's coding system.

TradingCapacity.name: Trading Capacity
TradingCapacity.definition: Specifies the role of the trading party in the transaction.

TradePostingCode.name: Trade Posting Code
TradePostingCode.definition: Indicates how a trade is maintained in the clearing account.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

SettlementDetails.name: Settlement Details
SettlementDetails.definition: Provides settlement details such as the settlement amount or the place of settlement.

ClearingDetails.name: Clearing Details
ClearingDetails.definition: Provides clearing details such as the non clearing member identification or the settlement netting (or not) eligibility code.

GrossAmount.name: Gross Amount
GrossAmount.definition: Principal amount of a trade (price multiplied by quantity).

DepositoryOrPlaceOfListingPresenceRule.definition: Depository or PlaceOfListing must be present.

TradeIdentificationPresenceRule.definition: TradeIdentification Or TradeExecutionIdentification Or UniqueTransactionIdentifier Must be present.
